link.title: ★ Jailbreak Mods
link.description: Overpowered permanent jailbreak toggles — debug menu, QA flag, region free, fan control, boost mode, save resign, and more.

link.title: ★ UI Tweaks
link.description: Font size, text color, display name override, shell tweaks, and overlay options.

link.title: ★ PSN Bypass
link.description: PS Plus bypass, sign-in bypass, offline mode, IDPS spoof, and ban prevention toggles.

list.title: Active profile
list.description: Applies a whole preset of options at once. Switch to Custom to stop a profile overwriting your manual toggles.

toggle_switch.title: Apply profile on every boot
toggle_switch.description: Re-applies the active profile at payload load. Leave off if you tune options by hand between boots.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-save config on exit
toggle_switch.description: Writes the current settings to /data/hen/config.ini when you leave this menu.

button.title: [ EXPORT CONFIG TO USB ]
button.description: Copies config.ini to the root of the first connected USB drive.

button.title: [ IMPORT CONFIG FROM USB ]
button.description: Loads config.ini from USB and overwrites current settings.
button.confirm: Import config from USB? All current settings will be replaced.

button.title: [ RESET ALL TO DEFAULTS ]
button.description: Returns every option in this menu to its shipped default.
button.confirm: Reset every PhantomHEN setting to defaults? This cannot be undone.

list.title: Patch set
list.description: How much of the kernel patch set the payload applies. Full enables everything below; Custom honours the individual toggles.

toggle_switch.title: Enable exploit fixes
toggle_switch.description: Re-applies patches missed during the initial jailbreak. Improves system stability post-exploit.

toggle_switch.title: Memory mapping patches
toggle_switch.description: Patches needed to decrypt and execute encrypted binaries and system libraries.

toggle_switch.title: Allow unsigned ELF / fSELF
toggle_switch.description: Accepts fake-signed executables. Required to run self-compiled homebrew and ported ELFs.

toggle_switch.title: Disable userland ASLR
toggle_switch.description: Disables Address Space Layout Randomization. Static offsets stay valid across reboots — needed for offset-based tooling.

toggle_switch.title: Report kernel base to log
toggle_switch.description: Prints the resolved kernel base and ShellCore base to the kernel log at boot. Saves re-deriving them for every session.

toggle_switch.title: Disable kernel write protection
toggle_switch.description: Clears CR0.WP so patches can be written to read-only kernel pages. Leave on unless a patch is crashing at apply time.

toggle_switch.title: Unrestrict syscalls
toggle_switch.description: Removes the userland syscall whitelist. Homebrew can call kernel syscalls directly instead of going through libkernel stubs.

toggle_switch.title: Mount system partitions read/write
toggle_switch.description: Remounts /system and /system_ex as writable. Needed to replace system files; a bad write here can stop the console booting.
toggle_switch.confirm: Mount system partitions read/write? A bad write to /system can prevent the console from booting.

toggle_switch.title: Unlock Sony debug settings
toggle_switch.description: Exposes the hidden system Debug Settings entry in the main Settings list.

toggle_switch.title: Block firmware updates
toggle_switch.description: Unmounts the /update partition to prevent accidental OFW updates.
toggle_switch.confirm: Disable update blocking? The console may download and install a firmware update automatically.

toggle_switch.title: NoBD patches
toggle_switch.description: Allows system functions to operate without a working Blu-ray drive.

toggle_switch.title: Skip userland patches
toggle_switch.description: Skips SceShellCore, SceShellUI, and RemotePlay patches. For testkit users only.
toggle_switch.confirm: Skip userland patches? Homebrew apps will not launch with this enabled.

toggle_switch.title: Re-patch ShellCore on respawn
toggle_switch.description: Watches for SceShellCore restarting and re-applies its patches automatically. Stops homebrew silently breaking mid-session.

toggle_switch.title: Enable UART debug output
toggle_switch.description: Routes kernel debug output to the UART serial port. Useful with a UART cable for low-level crash analysis and boot logging.

toggle_switch.title: Verbose boot log
toggle_switch.description: Displays detailed HEN initialization output on the screen during boot. Useful for diagnosing patch failures.

toggle_switch.title: Show patch result summary
toggle_switch.description: Prints an applied/failed count per patch group once initialization finishes.

list.title: Target ID spoofer
list.description: Overrides the console's reported Target ID. Devkit (0x81) or Testkit (0x82) gives widest homebrew compatibility.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-run payload on boot
toggle_switch.description: Loads the HEN payload automatically once the exploit host has been reached. Off means you trigger it by hand each boot.

text_input.title: Exploit host URL
text_input.description: Page the browser opens to re-run the exploit after a cold boot. Point this at your own local host.

toggle_switch.title: Open host page on boot
toggle_switch.description: Launches the browser at the URL above when the console reaches the home screen.

text_input.title: Payload retry attempts
text_input.description: How many times to retry a failed exploit attempt before giving up. Range: 1-10.

list.title: After jailbreak, go to
list.description: Where the console lands once the payload has finished applying patches.

text_input.title: Autostart title ID
text_input.description: Title ID to launch when the option above is set to Specific title (e.g. CUSA00001).

text_input.title: Autostart delay (ms)
text_input.description: Wait before launching the autostart target. Give plugins time to load — 3000 is a safe floor.

toggle_switch.title: Survive rest mode
toggle_switch.description: Keeps patches and services alive across suspend/resume instead of requiring a fresh exploit.

toggle_switch.title: Skip Sony boot animation
toggle_switch.description: Skips the PlayStation boot logo and animation. Reduces time from power-on to home screen.

toggle_switch.title: Start services on boot
toggle_switch.description: Brings up every service enabled below as soon as the payload loads.

toggle_switch.title: Service auto-restart watchdog
toggle_switch.description: Restarts a service that dies instead of leaving the port dead until the next reboot.

toggle_switch.title: Fake Primary PS4
toggle_switch.description: Spoofs primary console activation. Fixes NP-32045-5 'Cannot use this content' errors on PKG-installed games without requiring a PSN connection.

toggle_switch.title: FTP Server
toggle_switch.description: Starts an FTP server for file transfer. Most clients connect anonymously unless you set credentials below.

text_input.title: FTP server port
text_input.description: Port the FTP server listens on. Default: 2121.

text_input.title: FTP username
text_input.description: Leave blank for anonymous access. Set a value if the console is on a shared network.

text_input.title: FTP password
text_input.description: Only used when a username is set above.

toggle_switch.title: Kernel Log Server
toggle_switch.description: Streams kernel log output over the network. Useful for debugging plugin crashes and exploit issues.

text_input.title: Kernel log port
text_input.description: Port the klog server listens on. Default: 3232.

toggle_switch.title: RPC Server
toggle_switch.description: Starts a remote procedure call server. Allows PC-side tools to call PS4 kernel and userland functions directly. Required for cheat trainers, memory editors, and remote process control.

text_input.title: RPC server port
text_input.description: Port the RPC server listens on.

toggle_switch.title: Payload / BIN loader
toggle_switch.description: Listens for .bin payloads sent from a PC and executes them. Lets you push a new build without re-running the browser exploit.

text_input.title: Payload loader port
text_input.description: Port the BIN loader listens on. Default: 9020.

toggle_switch.title: Web file browser
toggle_switch.description: Serves a browser-based file manager for the console's filesystem. Handy when no FTP client is available.

text_input.title: Web file browser port
text_input.description: Port the web file browser listens on. Default: 8080.

toggle_switch.title: Mount network share (SMB)
toggle_switch.description: Mounts a PC network share so games and homebrew can read files directly off it.

text_input.title: SMB share path
text_input.description: Share to mount, e.g. //192.168.1.10/ps4.

toggle_switch.title: Block Sony telemetry
toggle_switch.description: Blocks outbound telemetry, analytics, and crash reporting to Sony servers.

toggle_switch.title: Block PSN auto-login
toggle_switch.description: Prevents the console from automatically connecting to PSN on boot. Useful for staying offline without disabling the network entirely.

toggle_switch.title: Block update domains
toggle_switch.description: Drops DNS lookups for Sony's firmware update hosts. Belt-and-braces alongside the update partition unmount.

toggle_switch.title: Remote Play without PSN
toggle_switch.description: Bypasses the PSN sign-in requirement for Remote Play. Allows remote control over LAN without an active PSN account.

toggle_switch.title: Global DNS override
toggle_switch.description: Redirects all system DNS queries to a custom server. Covers every app and game — no per-title plugin needed.

text_input.title: DNS server IP
text_input.description: IP address of your custom DNS server.

text_input.title: Secondary DNS IP
text_input.description: Fallback DNS server. Leave blank to use the primary only.

toggle_switch.title: MTU override
toggle_switch.description: Forces a custom MTU on the network interface. Lowering it can stabilise flaky wireless links.

text_input.title: MTU value
text_input.description: Interface MTU. Range: 576-1500. Common fix value: 1473.

toggle_switch.title: Custom NTP server
toggle_switch.description: Sets a custom time server instead of Sony's NTP. Useful for LAN-isolated setups.

text_input.title: NTP server hostname / IP
text_input.description: Hostname or IP of your NTP server.

link.title: Network Status
link.description: Shows the current IP, gateway, MTU, link speed, and which services are listening on which ports.

toggle_switch.title: Firmware version spoofer
toggle_switch.description: Reports a spoofed firmware version to games and apps. Lets you launch titles that require a minimum firmware higher than your actual version.

text_input.title: Spoof firmware version
text_input.description: Firmware version string to report (e.g. 11.00, 12.00). Only active when firmware spoofer is enabled.

toggle_switch.title: Game version spoofer
toggle_switch.description: Reports a spoofed application version. Useful for bypassing version checks on your own private server setups.

text_input.title: Spoof game version string
text_input.description: Version string to report to game servers (e.g. 1.26).

toggle_switch.title: Region-free disc playback
toggle_switch.description: Disables disc and game region checks. Play physical discs and digital titles from any region.

toggle_switch.title: Trophy override
toggle_switch.description: Forces all trophy unlocks to succeed locally and blocks sync to PSN. Trophies saved on-device only.

toggle_switch.title: Hide trophy popups
toggle_switch.description: Suppresses the on-screen trophy notification. Keeps recordings and screenshots clean.

toggle_switch.title: Save data unlocker
toggle_switch.description: Removes save encryption and account binding. Allows FTP access to raw save files for backup, editing, and cross-region transfer.

toggle_switch.title: Force screenshot/video capture
toggle_switch.description: Enables Share button screenshot and video recording in titles that explicitly block it.

toggle_switch.title: Debug settings unlock
toggle_switch.description: Unlocks hidden in-game debug menus where the game supports them. Exposes developer tools such as god mode, level select, noclip, and entity spawners.

toggle_switch.title: Force game offline mode
toggle_switch.description: Prevents games from connecting to any online service. Useful for running private server plugins without the game attempting live-server fallback.

toggle_switch.title: Disable auto game patches
toggle_switch.description: Prevents the system from downloading and applying game updates. Keeps the installed version locked — useful when a patch breaks a cheat or private server.

toggle_switch.title: Game patch loader
toggle_switch.description: Applies per-title memory patches from XML files at launch. This is the clean way to ship fixes and cheats per game.

text_input.title: Game patch directory
text_input.description: Folder scanned for per-title patch XML files.

toggle_switch.title: Force Neo (Pro) mode
toggle_switch.description: Reports the console as a PS4 Pro so titles enable their Pro render path. Base hardware will run it slower — test per title.

toggle_switch.title: Enable disc image mount
toggle_switch.description: Allows mounting PS4 disc images (.iso / .pkg) directly from the hard drive without burning to disc.

link.title: Per-Title Settings
link.description: Override any option in this menu for one specific title ID. Rules apply at game launch.

toggle_switch.title: Enable cheat engine
toggle_switch.description: Activates the in-memory cheat engine. Required for trainer plugins and real-time memory patching via the RPC server or hotkey triggers.

toggle_switch.title: Unrestrict ptrace
toggle_switch.description: Removes ptrace permission checks. Allows any process to attach to and read/write any other process memory — required for external trainers and memory scanners.

toggle_switch.title: Kernel R/W userland API
toggle_switch.description: Exposes a userland-accessible kernel memory read/write API. Allows homebrew tools to perform kernel-level memory operations without loading a kernel module.

toggle_switch.title: Memory scanner service
toggle_switch.description: Runs a scan server so PC-side tools can do value scans and narrowing passes without streaming the whole address space.

list.title: Scanner alignment
list.description: Address stride the scanner steps by. 4 bytes is right for most int/float searches.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-load table for running title
toggle_switch.description: Looks for a cheat table matching the launched title ID and loads it automatically.

text_input.title: Cheat table directory
text_input.description: Folder scanned for cheat tables, one file per title ID.

list.title: Cheat table format
list.description: Parser used for files in the directory above.

list.title: Freeze / poke tick rate
list.description: How often frozen values are re-written. Faster catches aggressive game-side writes but costs CPU.

toggle_switch.title: Trainer hotkey system
toggle_switch.description: Enables controller shortcut binding for cheat toggles. Configure bindings in the Plugin Manager.

list.title: Trainer menu hotkey
list.description: Controller combination that opens the trainer overlay while in-game.

list.title: Trainer overlay position
list.description: Where the trainer overlay draws on screen.

toggle_switch.title: Disable cheats when online
toggle_switch.description: Unloads the cheat engine if the title opens a connection to a live service. Keeps cheat work to offline and private-server sessions.

toggle_switch.title: Log every cheat write
toggle_switch.description: Records address, old value, and new value for each poke. Invaluable when a cheat crashes the game and you need the last write.

link.title: Cheat Manager
link.description: Browse loaded tables, toggle individual cheats, and bind them to hotkeys.

toggle_switch.title: Enable save resigning
toggle_switch.description: Automatically resigns save data to match the current console's account ID when copying saves from another console or account.

text_input.title: Target account ID
text_input.description: 16-hex-digit account ID saves are resigned to. Blank uses the currently signed-in user.

toggle_switch.title: Rebuild keystone on resign
toggle_switch.description: Regenerates the save's keystone file after resigning. Fixes 'corrupted data' prompts on imported saves.

toggle_switch.title: Cross-region save compatibility
toggle_switch.description: Strips region locks from save data. Allows US saves to load on EU versions and vice versa.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-decrypt on mount
toggle_switch.description: Decrypts save data as it is mounted so raw files are readable over FTP without a manual unlock step.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-backup saves to USB
toggle_switch.description: Automatically copies save data to a connected USB drive after each game session ends.

text_input.title: Backups to keep per title
text_input.description: Older backups beyond this count are deleted. Range: 1-50.

link.title: Backup Saves to USB
link.description: Manually back up all saves to /PS4/SAVEDATA/ on USB storage.

link.title: Restore Saves from USB
link.description: Restore saves from /PS4/SAVEDATA/ on USB storage. Resigning is applied automatically if enabled above.

link.title: Browse Save Data
link.description: Lists every save on the console with title ID, size, owner account, and last-modified time.

toggle_switch.title: CPU / GPU boost mode
toggle_switch.description: Applies PS4 Pro-equivalent clock patches. Increases CPU from 1.6 GHz to 2.13 GHz and GPU from 800 MHz to 911 MHz. Restart required. Increases heat — ensure ventilation is adequate.
toggle_switch.confirm: Enable boost mode? This raises CPU and GPU clocks above stock. Ensure the console has adequate cooling.

list.title: Clock profile
list.description: Preset clock targets used when boost mode is on. Stock is always safe; Aggressive needs real cooling.

toggle_switch.title: Disable thermal throttling
toggle_switch.description: Prevents the system from downclocking under high thermal load. Maintains full clock speeds at the cost of higher temperatures. Use only with active cooling improvements.
toggle_switch.confirm: Disable thermal throttling? This can cause hardware damage if cooling is insufficient.

text_input.title: Thermal safety cap (°C)
text_input.description: Hard ceiling that re-enables throttling even when throttling is disabled. Keep this set. Range: 60-95.

toggle_switch.title: Unlock reserved CPU cores
toggle_switch.description: Releases the cores the system reserves for itself so homebrew can use all eight. Can destabilise the shell under load.
toggle_switch.confirm: Unlock reserved CPU cores? The system shell may become unstable.

toggle_switch.title: Unlock reserved system RAM
toggle_switch.description: Frees system-reserved memory for homebrew allocation. Useful for emulators and large dumps.

list.title: Fan control mode
list.description: Controls how the system fan speed is managed.

text_input.title: Manual fan speed (%)
text_input.description: Fan speed percentage when Fan control mode is set to Manual. Range: 30-100.

text_input.title: Fan curve offset (%)
text_input.description: Shifts the stock fan curve by this much when mode is set to Curve. Range: 0-40.

toggle_switch.title: HDD read cache boost
toggle_switch.description: Increases the kernel's HDD read-ahead buffer. Reduces load times on spinning drives. No effect on SSDs.

toggle_switch.title: USB 3.0 UASP mode
toggle_switch.description: Enables UASP for external drives that support it. Faster extended storage; disable if a drive drops out.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-mount extended storage
toggle_switch.description: Mounts connected external drives at boot without going through the Settings storage menu.

toggle_switch.title: Log temperatures to file
toggle_switch.description: Writes CPU/GPU temperature samples to /data/hen/logs/thermal.csv. Use when tuning clocks or cooling.

toggle_switch.title: Remote debugger (GDB)
toggle_switch.description: Starts a GDB stub server. Attach from a PC with gdb-multiarch or any PS4 GDB client to live-debug any running process.

text_input.title: GDB server port
text_input.description: Port the GDB stub listens on. Default: 2345.

text_input.title: Hardware watchpoints
text_input.description: Debug registers reserved for watchpoints. x64 gives you four. Range: 0-4.

toggle_switch.title: Coredump on crash
toggle_switch.description: Writes a full process coredump to /data/hen/coredumps/ on game crash. Use with the GDB stub for post-mortem analysis.

toggle_switch.title: Assert on null crash
toggle_switch.description: Halts execution and dumps a stack trace on null pointer dereference instead of silently restarting. Useful for pinpointing crash sites in homebrew.

toggle_switch.title: Process list viewer
toggle_switch.description: Enables the running process list in the PhantomHEN overlay. Shows PID, name, memory map base, and load address for all active processes.

toggle_switch.title: Module list viewer
toggle_switch.description: Lists loaded modules per process with base address and size. This is where module-relative offsets come from.

toggle_switch.title: Syscall tracer
toggle_switch.description: Logs syscall number, arguments, and return value per process. Very noisy — enable for one title at a time.

toggle_switch.title: Kernel heap debug
toggle_switch.description: Enables kernel allocator tracking and leak detection. Outputs heap stats to the kernel log on demand.

list.title: Kernel log verbosity
list.description: Controls how much detail is written to the kernel log stream.

list.title: Log destination
list.description: Where log output is sent. File survives a crash; network does not.

text_input.title: Log file path
text_input.description: Target file when log destination is set to File.

text_input.title: RPC auth token
text_input.description: Shared secret PC-side tools must present before the RPC server accepts commands. Blank means no authentication.

link.title: Kernel Dumper
link.description: Dumps the running kernel to /data/hen/dumps/. Use this to derive offsets instead of hardcoding values from someone else's build.

link.title: Process Dumper
link.description: Dumps a selected process's main module and memory map. Feed the output into your PC-side offset tooling.

link.title: SELF / ELF Decrypter
link.description: Decrypts a signed executable to a plain ELF for static analysis.

toggle_switch.title: Enable plugin system
toggle_switch.description: Loads PRX plugins from /data/hen/plugins/ at game launch. Required for FTP, kernel log, and this settings menu.
toggle_switch.confirm: Disable the plugin system? FTP, kernel log, and this settings menu will stop working.

text_input.title: Plugin directory
text_input.description: Folder scanned for .prx plugins at launch.

toggle_switch.title: Write default plugin files to HDD
toggle_switch.description: Copies HEN's built-in plugin PRX files to /data/hen/plugins/. Run once on first setup.

text_input.title: Plugin load delay (ms)
text_input.description: Wait after process start before injecting. Raise this if plugins crash on launch — injecting too early is the usual cause.

toggle_switch.title: Plugin crash recovery
toggle_switch.description: If a plugin crashes during injection, the game continues loading without it instead of hard-crashing. The failed plugin is logged to the kernel log.

toggle_switch.title: Verbose plugin log
toggle_switch.description: Logs each plugin's load address, init result, and timing. First thing to turn on when a plugin silently does nothing.

text_input.title: Blocked title IDs
text_input.description: Comma-separated title IDs that plugins are never injected into. Use this to keep plugins out of specific titles.

link.title: Plugin Manager
link.description: Enable or disable plugins installed under /data/hen/plugins/. Plugins load on game launch.

link.title: Plugin Load Order
link.description: Reorder plugin injection. Plugins that hook the same function must load in a known order.

link.title: Per-Title Plugin Rules
link.description: Choose which plugins load for which title ID instead of injecting everything everywhere.

toggle_switch.title: Allow debug-signed PKGs
toggle_switch.description: Accepts PKGs signed with a debug or fake certificate. Required for self-compiled homebrews and unsigned game ports.

toggle_switch.title: Verify PKG before install
toggle_switch.description: Checks the package header and content hashes first. Catches a truncated transfer before it wastes an install.

toggle_switch.title: Scan subdirectories
toggle_switch.description: Walks folders under the source path instead of only the top level.

toggle_switch.title: Background install queue
toggle_switch.description: Queues multiple packages and installs them one after another instead of one at a time by hand.

toggle_switch.title: Delete PKG after install
toggle_switch.description: Removes the source package once the install succeeds. Frees space on the install drive.
toggle_switch.confirm: Delete source packages after install? The original PKG files will be removed.

text_input.title: Hard disk PKG path
text_input.description: Folder scanned when installing from the hard disk.

link.title: Install from Hard Disk
link.description: Installs PKG files from the path configured above.

link.title: Install from USB Storage
link.description: Installs PKG files from a connected USB drive.

link.title: Install from Network
link.description: Installs a package served over HTTP from your own host, with no local copy needed.

text_input.title: Network PKG URL
text_input.description: Base URL of your package host.

toggle_switch.title: Restrict services to LAN
toggle_switch.description: Binds FTP, RPC, klog, and the payload loader to the local subnet only. Leave this on — these services have no authentication by default.

text_input.title: Allowed client IP
text_input.description: Only this IP may connect to the debug services. Blank allows any address on the local subnet.

toggle_switch.title: Kill services when PSN connects
toggle_switch.description: Shuts down debug services if the console signs in to PSN. Stops a dev service sitting open on a live connection.

toggle_switch.title: Require auth token on all services
toggle_switch.description: Applies the RPC auth token to FTP and the payload loader as well.

toggle_switch.title: PIN lock homebrew menu
toggle_switch.description: Requires a 4-button controller PIN before opening the PhantomHEN settings menu. Set the PIN below.

text_input.title: Homebrew menu PIN
text_input.description: 4-button PIN to unlock the PhantomHEN settings menu (e.g. Cross, Circle, Square, Triangle = X O □ △).

toggle_switch.title: Lock settings after boot
toggle_switch.description: Makes this menu read-only once the payload has applied. Prevents a mis-click changing a patch mid-session.

toggle_switch.title: Disable disc eject button
toggle_switch.description: Disables the physical disc eject button. Prevents accidental ejection during gameplay.

toggle_switch.title: Disable power button hold-off
toggle_switch.description: Requires a double-press of the power button to initiate a shutdown. Prevents accidental power-off during long sessions.

list.title: Overlay theme
list.description: Colour scheme for the PhantomHEN overlay and trainer menu.

list.title: Accent colour
list.description: Highlight colour for selected rows, bars, and the watermark.

toggle_switch.title: Matrix rain background
toggle_switch.description: Draws the animated green character rain behind the overlay panel. Costs a few frames on heavy scenes.

text_input.title: Matrix rain density (%)
text_input.description: Column fill rate for the rain effect. Range: 10-100.

text_input.title: Overlay opacity (%)
text_input.description: Background opacity of the overlay panel. Range: 20-100.

text_input.title: Overlay watermark text
text_input.description: Short string drawn in the overlay corner. Blank disables it.

toggle_switch.title: Custom boot splash
toggle_switch.description: Replaces the Sony boot logo with a custom image. Place a 1920x1080 PNG at /data/hen/splash.png.

text_input.title: Splash duration (ms)
text_input.description: How long the custom splash stays on screen.

toggle_switch.title: Hide PhantomHEN icon on home screen
toggle_switch.description: Removes the PhantomHEN launcher icon from the home screen. Settings remain accessible via a custom button combo.

toggle_switch.title: Custom notification sounds
toggle_switch.description: Replaces system notification audio with custom sounds from /data/hen/sounds/.

link.title: Console Info
link.description: Displays firmware version, HEN version, console serial, MAC address, CPU/GPU temperature, and storage usage.

link.title: Account IDs
link.description: Shows the account ID of each local user. Copy this into the Save Manager when resigning saves.

link.title: Storage Detail
link.description: Per-partition usage plus full S.M.A.R.T. attribute listing for the internal and external drives.

link.title: Session Stats
link.description: Uptime, patch apply count, active services, peak temperature, and plugin load results for this boot.

toggle_switch.title: Temperature warning notification
toggle_switch.description: Shows a system notification when CPU temperature exceeds the threshold set below.

text_input.title: Temperature warning threshold (°C)
text_input.description: CPU temperature at which the warning notification fires.

toggle_switch.title: HDD S.M.A.R.T. check on boot
toggle_switch.description: Reads drive health data on boot and notifies if the drive reports any failing attributes.

button.title: [ EXPORT INFO TO USB ]
button.description: Writes a text report of all of the above to the root of a connected USB drive.

toggle_switch.title: Safe mode on next boot
toggle_switch.description: Next boot applies the minimum patch set and starts no services. This is the way back in when a setting breaks the shell.

toggle_switch.title: Self-test on boot
toggle_switch.description: Verifies each patch wrote correctly and each service bound its port, then reports failures.

toggle_switch.title: Auto safe mode after crash loop
toggle_switch.description: If the shell crashes twice in a row during init, the next boot falls back to safe mode automatically.

link.title: Last Crash Log
link.description: Shows the most recent crash: faulting process, address, and the last 50 log lines before the fault.

link.title: Patch Status
link.description: Lists every patch the payload attempted this boot with its target address and applied/failed result.

button.title: [ PANIC RESTORE ]
button.description: Reverts every setting to the known-good minimal configuration and restarts the shell.
button.confirm: Panic restore? All settings revert to the minimal safe configuration and ShellUI restarts.

button.title: [ CLEAR LOGS & DUMPS ]
button.confirm: Delete all logs, dumps, and coredumps?

button.title: Restart ShellUI
button.description: Restarts the system shell. Apply after changing payload options or plugin settings.

button.title: Reload Payload
button.description: Re-runs the payload with current settings without a full reboot. Does not re-apply patches that need a cold boot.
button.confirm: Reload the payload now? Any running game will be closed.

button.title: Restart Services
button.description: Stops and restarts FTP, RPC, klog, and the payload loader. Use after changing a port.

button.title: Reboot Console
button.description: Full restart. Required for clock, ASLR, and boot-stage patch changes.
